contradictions.detail: AutoCheck shows 39,399 mi on 10/20/2023, then 36,347 mi on 03/26/2025 at Audi Palo Alto, then 49,931 mi on 12/18/2025. The 03/2025 reading is out of sequence; AutoCheck flags 'possible clerical error or rollback'. The later readings resume the upward trend and the listing's 52,500 fits, which points to a clerical error (likely 46,347), but it should be confirmed against the dealer RO.

The seller says the car was 'exclusively dealer-maintained'. The 10/20/2023 brake and maintenance entry at 39,399 mi is sourced as 'Service Record', not 'Dealer Service'. There is also a roughly 23,000-mile, two-year span (07/2020 to 06/2022) with no reported entries. This is not proof of a non-dealer visit or skipped service, only an inconsistency to resolve with invoices.

critical_evidence.evidence: No reported entry for S tronic fluid and filter service. The 10/20/2023 'Recommended Maintenance Performed' at 39,399 mi has no line items. The car is at 52,500 mi, past the 40k interval.
The seller states '100% stock and unmolested' and 'never tuned'. No scan of ECU/TCU software part numbers or flash counter is provided.

AutoCheck lists 'Cooling System Serviced' at Audi Palo Alto on 12/18/2025 at 49,931 mi, but its own summary classes that visit as an A/C service. There is no invoice showing pump or thermostat-housing replacement and no photo of the housing.
No reported entry for Haldex coupling fluid service in roughly 7 years and 52,500 mi.
No scan provided. The cluster is blacked out in the only interior gauge photo.

documentation.rationale: The identity half is present: VIN, a clean-title AutoCheck, one lease owner, a 9-entry service history mostly at Audi Palo Alto, and a full build sheet. The maintenance half is incomplete. There are no invoices, no line items for S tronic, Haldex or plugs, a two-year reporting gap, an ambiguous 'cooling system' entry, and no scan proving stock software.

condition.rationale: The photos show straight, glossy paint and factory wheels. A disclosed windshield star chip is visible, and a rear fender scuff is disclosed but not shown. The new tires are a claim without dates. No fault, leak or scan evidence either way, so condition defaults to unproven.

price_value.rationale: The $27,000 ask sits at the top of the mid-$20k band for 2019 S3s with 40-60k miles. A dealer 2019 Prestige with 58k miles is listed at $26,715. Undocumented 40k-mile driveline services, plus chip and scuff, pull value down further.

mission_fit.rationale: This is a dual-clutch automatic Audi. It does not fulfill the enthusiast brief, and it does not win decisively on reliability (EA888 coolant module, DCT, Haldex), on price (asking at the budget's max_price), or on documented condition.

logistics.rationale: Mountain View is roughly 75-80 miles from Carmel, with Audi dealers and independent VW/Audi shops nearby for a PPI. It is a CA-registered car with PSX payment and lien handling. PPI access is not yet confirmed, and the lease payoff adds a title-transfer step.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: It is a desirable spec for the model: a facelift car with S Sport/Magnetic Ride, Black Optic and blue over gray quilted seats. For Jason, though, it is an automatic sedan outside the manual-roadster brief.

evidence.mission_note: As a pragmatic bridge this S tronic automatic does not fulfill the enthusiast brief. It is asking at the budget's max_price with key driveline services undocumented, so it does not yet win decisively on reliability, price or proven condition. Its strengths are local availability, a clean one-owner lease history, and inspection access close to home.
evidence.rationale: The AutoCheck establishes identity, a clean title, no reported accidents, a single CA lessee since 2019, and a mostly Audi Palo Alto service trail, consistent with the listing's mileage. Observed issues are a photographed star chip in the windshield, a disclosed rear fender scuff, two open recalls (PODS and sunroof software), and one out-of-sequence odometer entry that reads as clerical given the later readings. The model's critical items remain open: there are no reported entries for S tronic or Haldex fluid service past 40k miles, the 12/2025 'cooling system serviced' entry may be an A/C visit rather than the water-pump/thermostat-housing job, and the never-tuned claim has no software scan behind it. The tire freshness claim lacks dates or an invoice, and the steering-wheel photo appears to be a studio image that may not show this car. The asking price sits at the top of the market band and at the budget's max_price. Likely catch-up servicing (DCT, Haldex, plugs, brake fluid) is estimated separately from the small known cosmetic and glass items.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the 12/18/2025 Audi Palo Alto RO, any S tronic and Haldex service ROs, the tire DOT codes, and the lease payoff details. Ask to book a PPI with an ECU/TCU software scan at an independent Audi/VW shop near Mountain View before any payment.
